 Order

The petitioner herein has called in question the inaction of the respondent in not granting compensation on certain structures standing on the land acquired by the National Highway Authority of India for widening of the National Highway No.66.
2.

The learned counsel for National Highway Authority of India has placed on record two supplementary awards indicating that the compensation has been awarded in respect of standing structures on the acquired land.
3. The petitioner's contention is that certain properties have been left out.
However no documents have been produced to substantiate what are the standing structures that are left out from the award.
Therefore, the petition stands disposed off, reserving liberty to approach the Deputy Commissioner concerned under sub-section 5 Section 3G of the National Highways Act, 1956 in accordance with law.
4. In view of the dismissal of the petition, pending interlocutory applications, if any, do not survive for consideration.
